sentences.text:
Opposite Parties
 Mr. A. Pradhan, Asc
 Coram: Justice V. Narasingh
 Order
17.08.2023 Order No.
02. 1.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The petitioner is an accused in connection with Special POCSO Case No. 40 of 2023, pending before the Court of the learned Additional District and Sessions Judge-cum-Special Court under POCSO Act, Angul arising out of Samal Barrage P.S. Case No. 144 of 2023 for alleged commission of offences under Sections 376(2)(n) of IPC r/w. Sec. 6 of the POCSO Act..
3. Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.439 Cr.P.C. by the learned ADJ-cum-Special Court, under POCSO Act, Angul, by order dated 29.05.2023 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.

entities.text: Additional District and Sessions Judge-cum-Special Court
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 4. On perusal of the 164 Cr.P.C. statement of the victim and her medical examination report, this Court is not inclined to entertain this bail application at this stage.
5. Leave is granted to the Petitioner to renew his prayer after examination of the victim.
6. Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of. .

(V. NARASINGH) Judge Soumya Signed by: SOUMYA RANJAN SAMAL Location: High Court of Orissa Date: 19-Aug-2023 13:35:20 Astasambhu Majhi vs State Of Orissa And Another .... ... on 17 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/107639255/
